attempt.note: an attempt ends below $50 (90% loss): cheap 0DTE contracts still trade at a few cents

options.note: replaced by the lottery sleeve on 2026-10-05 (both competed for the same small cash; the candidate backtest is stock-only momentum)

dynamic_universe.note: data/universe.json; the static 'universe' list is only the fallback when that file is missing

lottery.note: one earnings call per week on the strongest 126-day momentum name; stop after a 10x, a doubled pot or an empty budget; research/2026-10-02-ratchet.md

zero_dte.note: phase 1 of zero-or-hero until the account doubles, then momentum for good; parameters from research/2026-10-05-0dte-double.md (fewest attempts per doubling)

zdte_shadow.note: quotes only, never an order: the live same-day rule on TSLA / NVDA (and SPY for comparison) with real bid/ask, to measure single-stock spreads (research/2026-10-07-0dte-names.md assumed 10% for every name)

net_shadow.note: simulated only, beside the live 0DTE phase; research/2026-10-06-net-pit.md
